summary.zh: 修复登出后返回键重回已登录界面的问题。因签名更换，部分老版本可能升级失败，卸载重装一次即可，抱歉！
summary.en: Fixed the sign-out back-stack bug. Note: the signing key rotation may make upgrades fail on some old versions — uninstall, reinstall once, sign in again. Sorry!

items.zh: 修复登出后按系统返回键又回到已登录界面的问题
items.en: Fix back button returning to the signed-in UI after sign-out

items.zh: 修复登出与多账号切换后残留旧界面状态的问题
items.en: Clean navigation state after sign-out and account switches

items.zh: 登录页不再显示已保存的账号信息
items.en: The login page no longer lists saved accounts

items.zh: 致歉说明：签名更换导致部分老版本可能更新升级失败，卸载后重新安装并登录一次即可，给大家带来不便深表歉意
items.en: About the signing key rotation: if the update fails to install, uninstall and reinstall once, then sign in again. Sincere apologies for the inconvenience!
